propositions: Code-review finding thresholds are too loose: zero BLOCK votes across 162 post-recalibration changes; confirmed must-fix findings scored 0.0–0.60 against a 0.95 threshold that no real finding reached.

Plan-review advisory mandate inflates protocol load (~13 advisories/round, ~95% of remediation edits mint new findings), obscuring organic agent behavior; mandate must be loosened to judgment-based uptake.
Completion-verifier defects prevent durable FAIL verdict persistence; FAIL ratchets piecemeal across CI cycles; signed-children AC anti-pattern defeats the certifiable:false escape hatch.

Leaf plans drift from parent scope as leaves are claimed and edited; by epic close a leaf's ACs describe materially different deliverables than the parent declared; no plan-review criterion gates leaf-scope containment at claim time.

Plan-review claim gate exhibits verdict instability (INDETERMINATE↔BLOCK flips on unchanged plans) and non-monotonic remediation convergence (block counts oscillate as valid findings are fixed; each remediation mints new finer-grained findings).
A held-out adjudication must confirm b9c0's provisional 0.54 code-v2 threshold before relying on the code-review block in production; the first-pass derivation used a circular proxy.
